concerns.text: FR-001 requires ≥50,000 clips from CHiME-5. Tasks replace CHiME-5 with AMI/LibriSpeech (~4,300 clips) and rely on a documentation‑only deviation (T007d) instead of a formal spec amendment, weakening the functional requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – No task provisions for distributed execution
concerns.text: FR-002 mandates execution on a distributed computing environment (Kubernetes, Slurm, or Ray). The task list contains only local batch‑processing steps and lacks any task that provisions, configures, or validates a distributed runtime, violating the requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – T050g (Spec Amendment) and T050b (Pilot of 100 annotations)
concerns.text: FR-011 requires ≥1,000 human‑annotated transcripts. The plan implements a pilot of 100 clips (T050b) and creates a spec‑amendment document (T050g) via a task, but this does not constitute a constitutionally valid amendment (no version bump, PR process). The functional requirement is effectively weakened.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – No task implements FR-022 fallback
concerns.text: FR-022 specifies a phoneme‑level edit‑distance fallback when SSS fails on high‑reverb audio. No task creates or validates such a phoneme metric, leaving the mandatory fallback unimplemented.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 7 – T032 / T032b (Resource monitoring) but no deadline enforcement
concerns.text: SC-004 requires the entire pipeline to complete within 48 h on the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner. Existing resource‑monitoring tasks only check RAM/CPU usage; none enforce or verify the 48 h wall‑clock deadline, so the success criterion is not testable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – T050b (real human annotation) lacks AUC‑ROC computation
concerns.text: SC-006 demands an AUC‑ROC ≥ 0.85 for the human‑validation of SSS. The task list includes a synthetic correlation check (T050e) but provides no task that computes the AUC‑ROC on the real human annotations from T050b, leaving the requirement unverified.
